title: Four Winters and One Short Rule
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：eraser　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 eraser 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my brother ① used an eraser that no teacher in the class would have lent, and he said the using was the whole of the winter. The ② eraser, meaning the rubber itself and not the pencil, ran four winters and stayed unlent in the book; an eraser, he said, is the only thing in a class that is judged by how long it is left unlent.

Every ③ eraser in that class had the same short rule beside it, and the ④ eraser at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the exam and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An eraser, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to lend; my brother said the lending is the part that fills four winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the eraser was the whole of the page, meaning the mark removed and not the rubber. The ⑥ eraser, meaning the mark and not any of that, is the only thing on a page that everybody waits for and nobody lends; eraser, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a rubber and a mark. He said the mark is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ eraser had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short rule. The ⑧ eraser of the whole thing, my brother wrote in January, was one class and four winters of lending; eraser, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to lend. He said the lending was never mentioned.

The ⑨ eraser I remember is the one lent in the list, which closed in 1969 and is still described as the quietest in the class. An ⑩ eraser, my mother said in 1971, is the only one that improves by being lent; every eraser, she said, is a mark that has agreed to look like a rubber. She said the mark was the honest half.

answers.why: use an eraser 意为“使用橡皮”，1963 年哥哥用了一块班上没有一位老师肯借出的橡皮。
eraser 意为“橡皮”，指那一块本身而不是铅笔，它经过了四个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
eraser 意为“橡皮”，指班上每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
eraser 意为“橡皮”，指留给考试用的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
eraser 意为“擦掉之处、涂改的痕迹”，指页面上人人都等却无人借出的那样东西，叔叔说这处擦改就是那一页的全部。
eraser 意为“擦改”，指人人都等却无人借出的那样东西而不是那一块橡皮，是页面上人人都等、却无人借出的东西。
eraser 意为“橡皮”，指清单上写到、被登记的那一块，到 1967 年这一块成了清单里的一行。
eraser 意为“橡皮”，哥哥一月写道，整件事的擦改之事是一个班级和四个冬天的借出。
eraser 意为“橡皮”，我记得的是清单上登记的那一块，1969 年结束了，至今仍被说成班上最安静的一块。
eraser 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，一块橡皮是唯一会因为被好好借出而变得更好的东西。
